sloka: सप्ताष्ट दिवसान् राजा राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ।शांता तव सुता राजन् सह भर्त्रा विशाम् पते ॥१-११-१९॥
transliteration: saptāṣṭa divasān rājā rājānam idam abravīt ।śāṁtā tava sutā rājan saha bhartrā viśām pate ॥1-11-19॥

translations.english: O lord of people, O king, It has been decided to commence an important sacrificial rite. You may send your daughter Santa along with her husband to my city.
